playback_clock: Observed concurrent completion timestamps; all setup, decision, synchronization and inter-round elapsed time is debited; no buffer truncation.
transfer_censoring: curl exit 28 is a right-censored observation only for the predeclared impaired client; download_s is the censoring deadline, stall is a lower bound, and no segment is added to its buffer
qoe_semantics: model-estimated operational QoE from measured transport features; not a new subjective human score
